subject: Exchange implementation and installation complete
body: Implemented the append-only typed exchange, operator CLI, four-tool MCP server, approval withholding, derived state, inter-process concurrency control, persisted-history validation, symlink containment, JSON-RPC batches, and repository-root pinning.
